recording_units: ratios in decimal; log_total_assets base must be fixed before computation
pit_rule: available_at >= maximum verified dependency published_at; missing date=>PIT_UNVERIFIED
current_implementation: Only debt_ratio and cash_to_assets when explicitly VERIFIED inputs match scope/currency/unit; others readiness BLOCKED

formulas.log_total_assets: model contract must select log or log1p; no unannounced fallback
formulas.earnings_or_margin_volatility_8q: std(comparable quarterly earnings or margins, minimum 8 valid quarters)

disallowed: No EPS YTD subtraction, stock balance summation, artificial epsilon, present PE/PB inversion, non-PIT future data, global winsorization, or train-time transformation.
